descriptionChirho: Qal active: to plunder, loot, carry off goods or possessions as spoil of war or raiding, including all finite forms (perfect, imperfect, imperative, cohortative, jussive) and infinitives expressing purpose or result.
Qal active participle used as an agent noun: a plunderer, spoiler, or despoiler — one who habitually or characteristically takes plunder.
Nifal and Piel passive: to be plundered, looted, or despoiled — the passive counterpart indicating the victim or object suffers the action of plundering.
Qal passive participle: in a state of having been plundered or despoiled, describing the resultant condition of the object.
